thread:
alina: Quick sync — noticed retries causing duplicated prefixes for streaming function-calls proxied through the gateway. Repro steps below. Anyone else seeing this?

alina: Repro: client opens stream -> gateway proxies -> upstream OOM at ~token 1200 -> upstream restarts/hedged replica served -> client sees tokens 1..800 then 1..400 again interleaved. Heap traces attached.

mike: Ack. I saw a similar spike in errors last night around 22:10 UTC. Looks like hedged backends aren't honoring resume semantics.

sam: Is this KV-cache specific? or also with non-kv models?

alina: Mostly KV models because resumed replica doesn't have same KV window so replay diverges. We also saw it once on a cold replica for a short stream.

taylor: Root cause we dug into: when hedging, proxy spins up a new upstream and replays prefix from scratch unless request is explicitly resumable. We don't have a robust resume-token handshake on frontdoor<->upstream transport yet.

jess: Proposal: automatic retries for streaming only when all of: 1) request marked resumable/opt-in, 2) client provides resume-token or upstream issues monotonic tokens, 3) target replica can accept a cached-kv-snapshot. Otherwise we should failfast (and return a retry hint) instead of replays.

mike: +1 on the policy. Also add a per-request memory/inflight token budget to avoid OOM amplification from replayed prefixes. e.g. max_inflight_tokens per request enforced at edge.

alina: Implementation sketch: introduce a lightweight header/trailer pair: x-rw-resume-token: <base64> and edge tracks last-ack'ed token index. On hedged retry the new upstream must accept the token; if it responds reject/unknown, proxy must NOT replay. Fallback options: return a short non-streaming reply with retry hint or surface a 409/429.

sam: Concern: existing clients won't opt-in. Can't break them. We need a graceful default: streams default to failfast on hedging unless client sets x-rw-resumable=1. Single-shot calls keep old behavior.

taylor: Agreed. Make resumable opt-in (x-rw-resumable: 1). Default off. Expose per-route override in Console so customers can opt routes into resumable streaming.

jess: Obs requirements: add metric stream_replay_attempts, stream_resume_mismatch_count, and a sampled trace that includes upstream ids and truncated resume-token. Also log reason when resume rejected.

deploy-bot: rollout plan: feature-flagged gate default=off for edge. Canary 10% next week, 50% after smoke. Run dedicated load test focusing on duplicate-replay SLOs and memory amplification.

mike: Action items: (1) spec resume-token header + handshake (taylor), (2) implement per-request token budget + circuit (alina), (3) metrics + sampling (jess), (4) SDK/docs guidance + Console toggle (sam). I'll coordinate rollout with deploy-bot.

alina: I'll spin up a short RFC doc summarizing tradeoffs. TL;DR: opt-in streaming resume w/ explicit header, hedging disabled for non-resumable streams, failfast fallback. Seems reasonable?

sam: OK from infra side. :thumbsup:

taylor: I'll draft a handshake proto snippet. Example:

```
GET /v1/generate/stream
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-rw-resumable: 1
x-rw-resume-token: eyJvZmZzIjoxMjB9...\n```
\nUpstream replies with trailer `x-rw-resume-accepted: 1` or `0;reason`. If 0, proxy must not replay.

jess: One more thing: ensure billing/dedupe pipeline recognizes resume-token so duplicate tokens don't double-bill customers. Add a dedupe window keyed by resume-token in the billing path.

alina: Great. I'll link this thread into the RFC and start a checklist. Thanks folks.

mike: Thanks — looping this into the design doc. Closing loop.
